lowresFallbackSupport.interpretation: 6ppc LANCZOS support outside the projected 32ppc collision is reported at alpha>0, >=16, and >=128; distance is to nearest projected high-resolution support pixel in 6ppc coordinates. This measures fringe and possible silhouette displacement but does not certify rendered fallback parity.

acceptedNaturalResidual.classification: three disconnected single-row exposed F/M pinholes (2, 1, and 3 pixels); not a continuous wedge; retained unfilled for visual/native collision review
